Media and fonts are not mirrored. Upstream GitHub workflows, automatic plugin manifests and symlinks are omitted. Retained files are unchanged, including licenses, credits and notices. Some sample paths need assets not included here; see the pinned upstream sources.

Marketing Videos, Motion Lab and ESCAPEMENT are not part of this archive.
